entities.name: Milan Blagojević
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Milan Blagojević , better known as Španac was a Yugoslav partisan, Spanish-trained commando and republican volunteer in the Spanish Civil War and is credited for initiating the anti-fascist struggle in Yugoslavia during World War II. Partisan commander Milan Blagojević Španac was killed by the Chetniks in October 1941 in Požega.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Milan Blagojević , better known as Španac was a Yugoslav partisan, Spanish-trained commando and republican volunteer in the Spanish Civil War and is credited for initiating the anti-fascist struggle in Yugoslavia during World War II. Partisan commander Milan Blagojević Španac was killed by the Chetniks in October 1941 in Požega.
